author: FChecklist
body:
AUDIT: FAIL
Objective Understood: Reviewed worker task 'Tier2 fix: PR#80 round 5 -- close git/gh command-alias bypass' (risk tier: tier1) by reading the actual diff, not a self-report.
Standards Reviewed: AGENTS.md Operating Rule 7c structured audit protocol; risk-tier.py's deterministic tier classification.
Scope Confirmed: 
Evidence Recorded: The branch checked out for this task (worker/task-20260726-171226-tier2-fix--pr-80-round-5----close-git-gh) contains no diff against master at all -- git diff master...HEAD is empty and this branch is actually ~30 commits behind master with no unique commits of its own, matching the blank diff supplied in the review prompt. The real round-5 fix commit (3c1b76b, 'Round 5: close native git/gh command-alias bypass of the write gate') exists only on a separate sibling branch (worker/task-20260726-083833-build-interactive-session-write-gate--re) and was never merged, rebased, or cherry-picked into this task's branch, so it is not part of what is being proposed for merge here. I independently inspected that other branch's commit and ran its regression suite (tests/interactive_session_guard_test.sh, 82/82 pass) plus live-reproduced several of its specific claims against real git 2.43 and gh 2.45 binaries (one-shot -c alias.*= rejection, persistent [alias]/gh-alias resolution, and a -c include.path= config-injection variant I tried as a potential residual bypass -- the resolver correctly forwards the same config context to its own alias lookup, so that variant is not actually a bypass); the underlying engineering work looks sound. But since it is absent from this branch, approving this task -- especially given it is classified tier1, which triggers autonomous merge -- would close out a security-fix task while shipping nothing, leaving the git/gh alias-bypass open in master. This needs to be rejected and re-dispatched as a branch/merge-scope fix, not treated as ready. Issues found: The diff for this task is empty: git diff master...HEAD shows zero changes, and this branch has no commits unique to it over master.; The actual fix (commit 3c1b76b) lives on a different branch (worker/task-20260726-083833-build-interactive-session-write-gate--re) that was never integrated into this task's branch -- likely a dispatch/branch-setup error, not a code issue.; This branch is also ~30 commits behind current master (missing ~5800 lines of unrelated content master already has), so even a same-branch merge right now would not be a clean fast-forward.; Task title says 'Tier2 fix' but the dispatched risk tier for this review was tier1 (autonomous-merge-eligible) -- worth reconciling before any future re-dispatch of this same task, since tier1+approve on an empty diff is exactly the failure mode that would silently no-op a security fix.; Recommend: re-dispatch a follow-up task to actually merge/rebase 3c1b76b (or an equivalent) into a branch against current master, then re-review that real diff -- do not just re-approve this branch as-is.
Severity Classified: medium
Verdict: fail
Corrective Action Owner: Worker to address the findings listed above and resubmit.
Re-Audit Scheduled: Required after corrective changes are pushed.
